name: LudingPhys
description: IPhys created from LudingMat, for use with Law2_ScGeom_LudingPhys_Basic.

attributes.name: DeltMax
attributes.description: Maximum overlap between particles for a collision

attributes.name: DeltNull
attributes.description: Force free overlap, plastic contact deformation

attributes.name: DeltPMax
attributes.description: Maximum overlap between particles for the limit case

attributes.name: DeltPNull
attributes.description: Max force free overlap, plastic contact deformation

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only

attributes.name: k2
attributes.description: Slope of unloading and reloading elastic branch

attributes.name: kc
attributes.description: Slope of irreversible, tensile adhesive branch

attributes.name: kp
attributes.description: Slope of unloading and reloading limit elastic branch

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).
